title: Tech Note: The Enterprise Data Module: The Videos2000 Example Database

historical_commentary.text: This note is the seventh installment of a Tech Note series covering the Beta 1 version of 4D's Enterprise Data Module/DataGrid application, shifting focus from the individual modules and plug-ins covered in the prior six notes to a complete sample application, Videos2000, built on top of the platform. The Enterprise Data Module/DataGrid product line described here is a discontinued, superseded piece of 4D's history, and the series' framing around a still-in-Beta product from 2000 makes it chiefly of historical interest today, illustrating an early attempt at a modular, plug-in-driven data application framework that predates 4D's later, very different ORDA-based relational data model.
related_updates: The Enterprise Data Module / DataGrid product line described in this series has been discontinued and is no longer part of current 4D offerings

4D's modern relational/entity data access model (ORDA, introduced 2018) represents a substantially different, later approach to structured data handling than the modular DataGrid/EDM framework this note documents
